title: Correct distance calculation
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for the distance to the seismic source must be approximately 34 km.

title: Correct wave type identified
description: Essential: The answer for the first observed motion must state it was vertical oscillation (or up-and-down vibration).

title: Setup time difference equation
description: Important: The solution must set up the correct equation relating distance, wave speeds, and arrival time difference: s/v_S - s/v_P = Δt or equivalent.

title: Interpret P-wave and S-wave properties
description: Important: The reasoning must correctly associate P-waves with longitudinal/compressional motion (vertical oscillation) and S-waves with transverse motion (horizontal shaking).

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: The solution shows clear algebraic steps to solve the distance equation for the variable s.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The solution demonstrates unit conversion or verification that the final distance is in kilometers.

title: Incorrect time difference equation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly sets the time difference as t = s/v_P - s/v_S (wrong order), leading to a negative or incorrect distance.

title: Confusion of wave motion types
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly states the first observed motion was horizontal shaking, confusing the properties of P and S waves.
